authorship.humanDirection: Cobra Canyon tropical foliage readability and WebGL/Unity reuse

constraints: presentation only; never collision, terrain, or target authority
one isolated foliage cluster per quadrant
muted humid greens; no fluorescent cyan edge
flat chroma-key source removed locally to RGBA
one-pixel matte contraction and 12-pixel transparent-RGB dilation for mip safety
assets.prompt: Create one square 2-by-2 sprite atlas containing four separate complete vegetation clusters: a mature coconut palm, a dense rounded tropical hardwood canopy, a bamboo-and-banana understory cluster, and a low fern-and-scrub cluster. High-quality hand-painted realistic game foliage, readable silhouettes, natural restrained greens, orthographic side-on billboard views, each subject centered wholly within its quadrant. Perfectly flat solid magenta chroma-key background; no landscape, sky, floor, text, watermark, shadows, reflections, neon colour, or quadrant crossing.
